content: UEFA Nations League fixtures-results and standings pages expose structured bootstrap metadata in HTML: competitionId=2014, seasonYear/currentSeason=2027, and service base URLs including match.uefa.com, comp.uefa.com, standings.uefa.com, bracket-service.uefa.com, and fsp-draw-service.uefa.com. The fixtures page is a JS shell with a matches-calendar component keyed by competitionId/seasonYear, while match pages inline a richer structured match object with team IDs, display names, competition metadata, round, and kickoff time inside data-options.
